summary: End-to-end validation of both fixes: (A) /jobs hides bare leads from Smart Card and (B) TasksPanel renders 'Today's agenda' with scheduled appointments/jobs. Backend pytest 5/5 PASS. Mobile UI (390x844) flows 100% PASS for super-admin and cardonly accounts.

test_results.GET /jobs hides bare leads (no quote/inv: PASS - 0 leaked; total jobs 12 (was 13 with leaked leads previously)
test_results.Dashboard tasks-panel + tasks-agenda (su: PASS - 3 agenda-item-* nodes for today's appointments with time ranges 09:00-10:00 / 10:00-11:00 / 16:00-17:00 and 'Today' badge
test_results./trabajos tasks-panel + tasks-agenda als: PASS - same 3 items rendered above the jobs list
test_results.New job modal -> save (status default ne: PASS - 'Job created' toast, modal closes, job appears in 'New Lead' section, total jobs 12 -> 13
test_results.Manual task CRUD (add/check/delete) stil: PASS - task added, checked off, then deleted from completed list
test_results.cardonly Dashboard: tasks-panel renders,: PASS - panel present, agenda hidden, no console errors

observations: Agenda items correctly render 'Today' badge and HH:MM–HH:MM time range from the underlying scheduled_date/start_time/end_time of the appointment-sourced job.
Click on an appointment-sourced agenda item navigates to /citas as designed; for source=manual scheduled jobs it would navigate to /trabajos (path covered by code review).
Console emits a non-blocking shadcn warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' when opening New Job and Add Task dialogs. Accessibility nit only — not a functional bug.
Meta pixel warnings in console are unrelated to the app and harmless.
action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to New Job and TasksPanel quick-add area to silence shadcn a11y warning.

(Optional, non-blocking) On mobile, task-delete button is opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 — touch users can only delete from the 'Show completed' section after hover; consider always-visible delete on touch.
critical_code_review_comments: list_jobs bare-lead filter is exactly correct: new_lead + no quote_id + no invoice_id + no scheduled_date + source!=manual. Skipped when ?status= is provided, which is the right escape hatch for admin views.
create_job hard-codes source='manual' (after payload.model_dump()), so even if a client passes source in the body it cannot bypass the filter — safe.

TasksPanel agenda derives client-side from /jobs by scheduled_date<=today and status!='completed' — depends on /jobs returning scheduled jobs, which it does. Sort by scheduled_date then start_time is correct.
openAgendaItem routes by j.source==='appointment' to /citas else /trabajos — note: if a manual job is scheduled, it correctly lands on /trabajos.

Component reuses load() after add/toggle/remove and refetches /jobs only on mount — agenda will not auto-update when an appointment is booked elsewhere in the same session without a remount. Minor enhancement only.
